tools.name: list_bess_units
tools.description: List every NEM-registered grid-scale battery (DUID, station, region, MW/MWh, MLF, coordinates, is_commissioning, commercial_context). rev_per_mw_yr is trailing 365-day energy + FCAS revenue (NOT FPP), gross (no MLF), divided by Max Cap MW, then annualised over the days the unit actually had dispatch

tools.name: get_fleet_summary
tools.description: Fleet-wide snapshot: unit count, total capacity, revenue month-to-date, average spot price.

tools.name: get_battery_detail
tools.description: Deep-dive metrics for one battery by DUID (e.g. HPR1 = Hornsdale): revenue, dispatch, SOC, FCAS. WARNING: rev_today, energy_rev_today, fcas_rev_today and contingency_fcas_rev_today are MONTH-TO-DATE by default, not daily (matching the rev_mtd keys in fcas_breakdown) — do not report them as 'today's

tools.name: query_nem_data
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question about NEM BESS data; returns generated SQL, result rows and a plain-English explanation. Scope each question to roughly one region-month or less — aggregates spanning more (e.g. a full year by region, or per-day top-N across all regions) can exceed the 15s query timeo

tools.name: get_battery_revenue
tools.description: Daily gross-spot revenue by market (energy + FCAS) for one battery (DUID) over a date range. Daily grain only. This is the tool for total revenue questions — use get_battery_optimal only for the actual-vs-perfect-foresight benchmark, not as a revenue source (its 'actual' figure is MLF-adjusted and s

tools.name: get_battery_optimal
tools.description: Actual vs LP-optimal dispatch revenue, per-DUID summary, over a date range (energy-only, perfect-foresight benchmark). NOT a revenue-total source — use get_battery_revenue for that. Both the 'actual' AND the 'optimal' figures here are MLF-adjusted (get_battery_revenue's is gross) — the LP's objectiv

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List NEM spot-price events (negative, elevated, spike, extreme), optionally filtered by region.

tools.name: get_event_detail
tools.description: Summary stats for one market price event by id (per-interval dispatch during the event is not exposed).

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_battery_detail" stacks urgency/override words (always, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
